proposals: Fresh install verifies pointer-selected manifest bytes before using asset paths and records image/daemon-bound private evidence after authenticated MCP and byte checks. Subsequent upgrades reuse that evidence, never labels alone.

Program-only updates use one fixed verified foundation, not an indefinitely growing image-parent chain. Cold-layer incompatibility requires an explicit full install. Retained rollback/image GC is a separate explicit lifecycle.

Backups not implemented fail, and disposable smoke never resets an existing instance by name. Preserve disabled capabilities, credentials, volumes and host binding. Refuse unreplayable custom configuration.
Normalize Docker omitted User/WorkingDir strings only; retain strict argv and override checks. Controlled Program archives prove deployment behavior, not cross-version data compatibility.
